watchlist.thesis: The stock advanced 2.8% from Nov 5 to Nov 11 with liquid turnover and $9.6B of Q3 repurchases, but the 6% year-over-year decline in operating earnings keeps this a defensive rather than high-beta momentum setup.
A 2.9% five-session advance is backed by 6.5% global Q3 RevPAR growth and a raised FY26 RevPAR outlook, keeping the post-results uptrend constructive despite higher debt and Middle East exposure.
The stock has rebounded 10.1% from its Nov 3 close to $38.25 by Nov 11, with Q3 adjusted EPS up 22.2% and FY26 guidance reaffirmed, but slower Q4 coffee-profit growth remains a catalyst risk.
A 5.0% five-session gain to $105.81 follows Q3 sales growth of 10.5%, TMTT growth of 44% and raised 2026 guidance, though the post-earnings extension argues against chasing gaps.

sector_notes: U.S. equities staged a technology-led rebound on Nov 11: Nasdaq rose 1.60%, S&P 500 1.31%, Dow 0.49% and Russell 2000 0.9%; Massive daily bars show semiconductors leading, with SMH up 4.8% versus QQQ 2.3%, SPY 1.3% and IWM 0.9%. Industrials and financials participated while consumer discretionary was roughly flat, but AI/semiconductor leadership remains headline-sensitive and higher rate expectations argue for selective momentum rather than broad chasing.

earnings_flags.note: Q4 FY2026 earnings conference call is scheduled for Nov 12; event-day semiconductor equipment gap risk.
Q1 FY2027 earnings results are scheduled for Nov 12 at 4:30 p.m. ET; elevated post-close gap risk.
Q3 FY2027 results are scheduled for Nov 17; the company confirms a 5:00 p.m. ET conference call and written results commentary around 1:20 p.m. PT.
